args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions; `list_deployments` showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer.
3. **Rolled back** — The `rollback` tool to v2.3.0 failed repeatedly with 503 Service Unavailable (5 attempts). As an alternative, I used `deploy` to restore v2.3.0 to all production regions, which succeeded.

**Verification:** checkout-api is now on **v2.3.0** in all three regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.002.

**Note:** The rollback tool was unavailable, so I used the deploy path to restore the known-healthy version. The incident INC-0001 remains open and the on-call engineer has been paged; the unhealthy v2.3.1 should be investigated to prevent recurrence.
